Question 1

On which intervals is the function y=f(x), shown above, increasing?

a
 (−∞,−3), (−2,−1), (0,1), and (2,3)
b
 (−∞,∞)
c
 (−3,−1), (−1,1) and (1,3)
d
 (−∞,−3) and (3,∞)
e
 (−3,−2), (−1,0), (1,2), and (3,∞)
